name: OPENFIL.jcl
description:
This JCL job opens five CICS files in the CICSAWSA CICS region by issuing CEMT SET FILE OPEN commands through SDSF. It is used to make critical business data files available for online transaction processing after they have been closed for maintenance or after a system restart.Key Functionalities:
Opens the TRANSACT file in the CICSAWSA CICS region, making transaction data available for online processing.
Opens the CCXREF file in the CICSAWSA CICS region, enabling cross-reference data lookups.
Opens the ACCTDAT file in the CICSAWSA CICS region, making account data accessible for online transactions.
Opens the CXACAIX file in the CICSAWSA CICS region, enabling access to the account cross-reference alternate index.
Opens the USRSEC file in the CICSAWSA CICS region, making user security data available for authentication and authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICS region CICSAWSA is active and all five business files — Transaction (TRANSACT), Credit Card Cross-Reference (CCXREF), Account Data (ACCTDAT), Account Alternate Index (CXACAIX), and User Security (USRSEC) — are registered within it
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The CICS file activation job (OPCIFIL) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All five business files are activated in the following fixed sequence: (1) TRANSACT, (2) CCXREF, (3) ACCTDAT, (4) CXACAIX, (5) USRSEC — making all business data fully available for online processing in CICS region CICSAWSA

rules.Rule_Name: OPCIFIL - SDSF/CEMT - Sequential Activation of All Business Files in CICS Region
rules.Rule_Description: All five business files must be sequentially activated in the CICS region CICSAWSA as a mandatory prerequisite before any online business transactions can be initiated or processed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICS region CICSAWSA is active and the Transaction file (TRANSACT) is registered within it
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The CICS file activation job (OPCIFIL) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction file (TRANSACT) is opened and made fully available for reading and writing transaction records during online processing in CICS region CICSAWSA

rules.Rule_Name: OPCIFIL - SDSF/CEMT - Activate Transaction File for Online Processing
rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction file (TRANSACT) must be activated in CICS region CICSAWSA to make transaction records accessible for online business processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICS region CICSAWSA is active and the Credit Card Cross-Reference file (CCXREF) is registered within it
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The CICS file activation job (OPCIFIL) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Credit Card Cross-Reference file (CCXREF) is opened and made fully available for credit card-to-account mapping lookups in CICS region CICSAWSA

rules.Rule_Name: OPCIFIL - SDSF/CEMT - Activate Credit Card Cross-Reference File
rules.Rule_Description: The Credit Card Cross-Reference file (CCXREF) must be activated in CICS region CICSAWSA to enable the mapping of credit card numbers to their associated customer accounts during online transactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICS region CICSAWSA is active and the Account Data file (ACCTDAT) is registered within it
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The CICS file activation job (OPCIFIL) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Data file (ACCTDAT) is opened and made fully available for reading and updating customer account information in CICS region CICSAWSA

rules.Rule_Name: OPCIFIL - SDSF/CEMT - Activate Account Data File
rules.Rule_Description: The Account Data file (ACCTDAT) must be activated in CICS region CICSAWSA to enable access to core customer account information for online business operations.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICS region CICSAWSA is active and the Account Alternate Index (CXACAIX) is registered within it
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The CICS file activation job (OPCIFIL) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Alternate Index (CXACAIX) is opened and made fully available for alternate-key-based account data lookups in CICS region CICSAWSA

rules.Rule_Name: OPCIFIL - SDSF/CEMT - Activate Account Alternate Index
rules.Rule_Description: The Account Alternate Index (CXACAIX) must be activated in CICS region CICSAWSA to provide an alternate lookup path into the Account Data file, supporting multiple ways to retrieve account records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICS region CICSAWSA is active and the User Security file (USRSEC) is registered within it
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The CICS file activation job (OPCIFIL) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The User Security file (USRSEC) is opened and made fully available for user identity verification and access permission enforcement in CICS region CICSAWSA

rules.Rule_Name: OPCIFIL - SDSF/CEMT - Activate User Security File for Access Control
rules.Rule_Description: The User Security file (USRSEC) must be activated in CICS region CICSAWSA to enforce user authentication and access control for all online users before any business transactions are permitted.
